g.title: seq
g.text: 07a From obligation to payment: who certifies what, and which record each step writes (goods bought by a national agency, paid by payment order)

a.text: 1. Requesting office to Budget unit:
Obligation Request and Status (ORS) with the
contract or purchase order. Box A: charges are
necessary, lawful and under my direct
supervision, and the supporting documents are
valid, proper and legal
2. Budget unit: Check the allotment in the
registry. Assign the ORS number. Enter the
obligation in the registry. Box B: allotment
available and obligated. No journal entry
3. Accounting unit to Head of agency: Purchase
order or contract with the certificate of the
chief accountant: "Funds Available", and the
number, date and amount of the ORS
4. Head of agency to Suppliers and payees:
Signed purchase order or contract
5. Suppliers and payees to Property and
inspection: Delivery, with delivery receipt
and invoice
6. Property and inspection: Inspection and
acceptance report with the numbers of the
purchase order and of the invoice. Inspection
officer: inspected, verified and found in
order as to quantity and specifications.
Property custodian: accepted, complete or
partial
7. Property and inspection to Accounting unit:
Copy of the acceptance report, with the
purchase order and the delivery receipt
8. Accounting unit to Budget unit: Journal
entry voucher (JEV): debit the asset or
expense, credit Accounts Payable. The budget
unit enters the payable in part C of the ORS
9. Requesting office to Accounting unit: DV
with the original acceptance report, delivery
receipt, purchase order and a copy of the ORS.
Box A: expenses necessary, lawful and incurred
under my direct supervision
10. Accounting unit: Check the documents
against a list. Assign the DV number. Look
into the index of payments: was this claim
paid before? Compare the DV with the ORS. Box
B: the accounting entry
11. Accounting unit: Head of accounting looks
into the registry of the NCA. If the balance
is enough: enter the amount as used, and sign
Box C: cash available, supporting documents
complete, amount claimed proper. If not: keep
the DV until cash is available
12. Accounting unit to Head of agency: DV for
approval
13. Head of agency to Accounting unit: Box D:
approved for payment
14. Accounting unit to Head of agency: LDDAP-
ADA in five copies for the approved DVs. The
chief accountant signs "Certified Correct"
15. Head of agency to Cash unit: Signs
"Approved"
16. Cash unit: Enter it in the record of
checks and payment orders, with the new
balance of the NCA. The cashier signs the
advice to debit the account
17. Cash unit to Head of agency: LDDAP-ADA for
the second signature
18. Head of agency to Cash unit: Countersigns
the advice to debit the account
19. Cash unit: Stamp "PAID" on the payment
order, the DVs and the documents. Prepare the
summary list (SLIIE) in four copies. The
cashier certifies it, the head of agency
approves it
20. Cash unit to Servicing banks: Summary list
and LDDAP-ADA (paper copies, or through the
electronic facility of the bank)
21. Servicing banks: Check the payment order
and the NCA balance. Debit the MDS sub-account
of the agency
22. Servicing banks to Suppliers and payees:
Credit the account of the payee with the net
amount, not earlier than 24 hours and not
later than 48 hours after receipt
23. Servicing banks to BTr: One copy of the
summary list and of the LDDAP-ADA on the same
day
24. Treasury Single Account to Servicing
banks: Replenishment from the Treasury Single
Account
25. Servicing banks to Cash unit: Validated
copy of the LDDAP-ADA. Items that could not be
credited are marked as not paid
26. Suppliers and payees to Cash unit:
Official receipt, or other evidence that the
payment was received
27. Cash unit to Accounting unit: Daily report
of payment orders issued (RADAI) in four
copies, with the DVs and the validated LDDAP-
ADA
28. Accounting unit: JEV for the payment:
debit Accounts Payable, credit Cash-MDS,
Regular and Due to BIR. Enter it in the
journal of payment orders
29. Accounting unit to Budget unit: One copy
of the RADAI. The budget unit enters the
payment in part C of the ORS and the
disbursement in the registry
30. Accounting unit to BIR: Tax withheld:
returns filed in the electronic system of BIR,
paid by Tax Remittance Advice by the 10th day
of the next month. No cash moves
31. Accounting unit to COA audit team: First
copy of the RADAI and of the JEV, with the
original DV, its documents and the validated
LDDAP-ADA
32. COA audit team to Head of agency: Audit
observations, or notices of suspension or
disallowance (chapter 09)
